title: CallRecord (one LLM call, one JSONL line)
description: results.CallRecord as written by CallRecord.Log to <out>.calls.jsonl (Jackson record form, sorted keys). One line per HTTP-level request issued by the adapter, including cache hits (cached = true). The completion text is not in this record; join requestHash to the cache file's hash to recover it.

kind.description: talk: a talk-phase call of a chat arm (C5.5); several per round, so (kind, runKey, index) is not unique for talk. question: an in-game question call (C13.3), attempt 0, index = the round just played.

index.description: game/probe/talk: the 1-based round; vignette: the 0-based price-list row index (not the presentation position).

attempt.description: 0 = first call, 1 = the repair retry. Probes are always 0.

latencyMs.description: Provenance only; 0 on a cache hit; never part of a digest.

clamp.description: Present only when the context clamp (unit U2, --context-clamp on) bound on this call. A skipped call was not sent: tokensIn/tokensOut 0, parseStatus PARSE_FAIL, requestHash of the unsent request.

parseStatus.description: PARSE_FAIL at attempt 0: a truncated-thinking reply (C12b.3), imputed without a repair.
